title: Healthcare Cost Analytics with Multivariate Methods
subtitle: Completed master's coursework project · Healthcare Analytics
description: Multivariate analysis project focused on understanding and modeling annual medical insurance costs using dimensionality reduction, categorical data analysis, clustering and supervised classification techniques.
highlights: Analyzed a healthcare insurance dataset with demographic, clinical, lifestyle, policy and cost-related variables.
Applied PCA to synthesize economic, contractual and clinical information into interpretable latent dimensions.
Combined PCA with regression modeling to study annual medical cost while reducing multicollinearity.
Used MCA to explore associations between categorical health, lifestyle and personal profile variables.
Applied clustering on MCA coordinates to identify homogeneous behavioral and insurance-related profiles.
Built LDA models to classify insured individuals into low, medium and high annual cost groups.
